FIELDS.NAME: Burger Bites Family Grill
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Burger Bites Family Grill operates as a quick-service family restaurant, offering a variety of freshly prepared meals including burgers, sandwiches, salads, and sides, with a focus on quality ingredients and fast service. Our establishment maintains a seating capacity of up to 150 guests, ensuring a comfortable dining atmosphere while adhering to all health and safety regulations. We operate daily from 10 AM to 10 PM, providing dine-in, takeout, and limited delivery services, with all drivers vetted and vehicles insured to mitigate commercial auto liability risks. Our menu includes limited sales of beer and wine, accounting for less than 25% of total sales, ensuring compliance with liquor liability coverage requirements. We prioritize regular maintenance of our kitchen equipment and fire suppression systems, and have robust food safety protocols in place, resulting in no history of major health code violations or foodborne illness outbreaks. Our committed staff undergoes consistent training on safe food handling and emergency procedures, aiming to create a pleasant dining experience for families in our community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred when a customer tripped over a wet floor that had not been properly marked with signage. The claim resulted in a payout of $2,500 for medical expenses. The status of this claim is closed. Additionally, on June 20, 2023, a small fire ignited in the kitchen due to an equipment malfunction, leading to $700 in damage for repairs. This incident is also closed. Total losses amount to $3,200.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class 1, Grade B, Secured Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with monitored video surveillance and regular patrols by security personnel.

Our operations are focused on food service, adhering to all relevant health and safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Burger Bites Family Grill sponsors local athletic teams as part of its community engagement efforts to promote health and fitness. We believe in supporting our local youth and fostering team spirit.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are checked by our operations manager to ensure compliance and risk management.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Burger Bites Family Grill has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The establishment has maintained a positive insurance history.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Burger Bites Family Grill does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed by the restaurant.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Burger Bites Family Grill currently does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as indicated in our records. However, we are committed to maintaining compliance with all legal requirements regarding employee coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Burger Bites Family Grill also owns and operates Burger Bites Catering Services, which provides additional food service options for events and gatherings.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Burger Bites Family Grill does not currently have any other insurance policies with this company. We only hold the existing policy for our restaurant operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Burger Bites Family Grill is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus exclusively on food service in a quick-service restaurant setting.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Burger Bites Family Grill does not rent or loan equipment to others; all equipment is utilized solely for our restaurant operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Burger Bites Family Grill has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial status and has a positive insurance history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Burger Bites Family Grill does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as our focus is solely on food service within a safe and regulated environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Burger Bites Family Grill does not have any known exposure to catastrophes, and we operate in a manner that prioritizes risk management and safety compliance.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Burger Bites Family Grill has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize compliance and safety, maintaining a positive track record in these areas.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are currently no uncorrected fire code violations at Burger Bites Family Grill, and we prioritize compliance with all fire safety regulations. Regular inspections and maintenance of our fire suppression systems are conducted to ensure safety.
